title: The Unwritten Ledger
subtitle: Caste, Atrocity & the Record — a counter-archive of the Indian subcontinent
abstract: GSS Anarchive · Collection 04. A counter-archive of caste, atrocity and refusal in the Indian subcontinent — organized as a double-entry ledger between what the state enters in the register and what the register cannot hold. Follows the FIR that was never filed, the atrocity where the court found 'no caste motive,' the assembly ballot Ambedkar named for what it was, and the Buddhist conversion of October 1956 — twelve files, keyed to the ruled line of a state ledger. Design conceit: two columns — Ambedkarite blue for the recorded claim, gold for the unrecorded testimony.
